meta_description: Core training foundation for Mitsubishi showroom consultants from first contact to commitment.
body_html:
Goal

Build a repeatable showroom flow that increases conversion quality, not just conversation volume.

Flow

  1. Qualify needs and budget comfort.
  2. Match model and variant to usage.
  3. Present value and financing scenarios.
  4. Handle objections with structure.
  5. Confirm readiness and proceed to SPK.

Standard

Keep communication clear, specific, and transparent at every step.

meta_description: Practical qualification framework for Mitsubishi sales teams to improve recommendation accuracy.
body_html:
Purpose

Qualification prevents mismatched offers and improves customer confidence.

Questions to Cover

  • How will the vehicle be used daily?
  • What monthly payment feels safe?
  • When is the target purchase date?
  • Who is involved in final decision?

Outcome

A clear profile that guides product and financing recommendation.

meta_description: Simple method to present Mitsubishi financing options with clarity and trust.
body_html:
Method

  1. Present at least two DP and tenor options.
  2. Highlight DP, installment, and total payment.
  3. State assumptions and approval dependency clearly.

Good Practice

Avoid jargon and make trade-offs explicit so customers can decide confidently.

h1: Objection Handling Guide for Sales Consultants
meta_description: Structured objection handling guide for Mitsubishi consultants in real customer conversations.
body_html:
Loop

  1. Clarify the concern.
  2. Validate customer perspective.
  3. Answer with relevant evidence.
  4. Confirm resolution and move forward.

Focus

Stay consultative, avoid defensive language, and protect deal quality.

h1: Test Drive to SPK Conversion Method
meta_description: Execution method to improve conversion from test drive into signed SPK.
body_html:
Before Drive

Set evaluation focus based on qualified needs.

During Drive

Guide only on relevant features and ownership fit.

After Drive

Recap customer feedback, connect to recommendation, and present next step immediately.

h1: SPK Accuracy and Deal Quality Control
meta_description: Checklist guide for Mitsubishi teams to maintain SPK accuracy and reduce post-signing issues.
body_html:
Checklist

  • Correct model, variant, and color
  • Matched pricing and promo terms
  • Clear payment path and assumptions
  • Documented delivery timeline notes

Result

Higher trust and fewer avoidable cancellations.

meta_description: Communication standard for customer updates between SPK and handover.
body_html:
Cadence

Use weekly or milestone-based updates even when no major change occurs.

Message Structure

  • Current status
  • Next expected milestone
  • Next update date

Impact

Consistent updates reduce uncertainty and cancellation risk.

h1: Daily Sales Routine and Funnel Hygiene
meta_description: Daily routine guide to keep pipeline discipline and conversion momentum.
body_html:
Daily Minimum

  • All active leads have next action.
  • Follow-ups are completed and logged.
  • Aging leads are requalified or closed.

KPI Lens

Track inquiry-to-test-drive, test-drive-to-SPK, and SPK-to-delivery daily.

meta_description: Weekly coaching structure for Mitsubishi sales managers to improve field execution.
body_html:
Structure

  1. Review consultant KPI gap.
  2. Identify one behavior to improve.
  3. Run role-play from real case.
  4. Set measurable action for next week.

Principle

Frequent small improvements outperform occasional large training.

meta_description: Framework for Mitsubishi fleet conversations focused on operations and uptime value.
body_html:
Priority Areas

  • Operational fit and payload suitability
  • Service coverage and response readiness
  • Downtime risk and maintenance planning
  • Total ownership economics

Output

A proposal that addresses business performance, not just purchase price.

meta_description: Delivery-day handover guide connecting sales and aftersales to improve retention.
body_html:
On Handover Day

  • Introduce service contact point
  • Confirm first maintenance schedule
  • Explain support channels clearly

Outcome

Customers feel supported after purchase and are more likely to return and refer.

meta_description: Communication principles for Mitsubishi sales teams to build trust throughout the buying journey.
body_html:
Principles

  • Be specific, not vague.
  • Set clear deadlines for answers.
  • Follow through exactly as promised.
  • Document key agreements in writing.

Result

Trust grows when customers experience consistency and reliability in every interaction.

meta_description: Playbook for building predictable Mitsubishi pipeline growth through prospecting and lead reactivation.
body_html:
Objective

Create stable lead inflow and recover dormant opportunities with consistent routines.

Execution Blocks

  • Daily outbound window with segmented lists
  • No-show recovery within one hour
  • Cold lead reactivation with updated value hook
  • Weekly review of reactivation conversion

Expected Result

Better top-of-funnel stability and lower lead leakage.

meta_description: Guide for Mitsubishi teams to negotiate confidently while protecting deal quality and pricing discipline.
body_html:
Core Principle

Negotiate with structure, not emotion.

Rules

  1. Reconfirm customer priority before concession.
  2. Use approved concession ladder only.
  3. Escalate exceptions through manager approval path.
  4. Document final agreement clearly in SPK notes.

Outcome

Higher margin consistency and fewer post-deal conflicts.

h1: Corporate and Fleet Account Growth Framework
meta_description: Framework for growing Mitsubishi corporate and fleet accounts with operationally credible proposals.
body_html:
Framework

  1. Map account stakeholders and decision flow.
  2. Diagnose operational needs and downtime impact.
  3. Build phased proposal with support commitments.
  4. Set quarterly account review cadence.

Success Metric

Growth in repeat unit orders and stronger retention in key accounts.

h1: Branch Execution Rhythm and Morning Huddle Standard
meta_description: Operational standard for branch leaders to align team focus and daily sales execution.
body_html:
Morning Huddle Template

  • Yesterday conversion snapshot
  • Today priority deals and risks
  • Aging lead action focus
  • One skill reminder for field execution

Daily Rhythm

Keep communication short, data-backed, and action-focused to improve team consistency.

h1: Showroom Opening and Morning Huddle SOP
meta_description: Daily SOP for opening readiness and morning huddle execution in Mitsubishi sales branches.
body_html:
Opening Checklist

  • Facility and display readiness
  • Demo unit status check
  • Lead queue and appointment review
  • Team attendance confirmation

Morning Huddle

  • Yesterday KPI snapshot
  • Today's target opportunities
  • Risk deal escalation points
  • One execution focus for the day

Target

Complete both activities before customer peak period with clear action ownership.

meta_description: SOP to manage inbound lead assignment and response SLA for stronger conversion consistency.
body_html:
Scope

Covers digital leads, call-ins, and walk-in overflow handling.

Standard

  1. Assign lead immediately by capacity and specialization.
  2. Send first response within branch SLA.
  3. Log next action and timestamp in CRM.
  4. Escalate uncontacted leads at SLA breach threshold.

Outcome

Lower lead loss and more predictable top-of-funnel performance.

h1: SPK Submission and Delivery Day SOP
meta_description: Operational SOP from final SPK submission to professional delivery-day execution.
body_html:
Before SPK Submission

  • Run order accuracy check
  • Confirm pricing and promo details
  • Validate payment path and documentation
  • Secure required approvals

On Delivery Day

  • Verify unit and document completeness
  • Conduct customer orientation
  • Introduce aftersales contact
  • Confirm first service schedule

Result

Cleaner execution, fewer disputes, and stronger customer trust.

meta_description: SOP for handling complaints and documentation compliance in Mitsubishi sales operations.
body_html:
Complaint Escalation

  1. Classify issue severity.
  2. Assign owner and response deadline.
  3. Provide customer update cadence.
  4. Confirm closure and root-cause note.

Compliance Control

  • Check mandatory financing and consent records
  • Complete approval and exception trail
  • Archive final transaction package

Goal

Protect customer experience and keep branch operations audit-ready.

meta_description: SOP for handling after-sales complaints with clear ownership, SLA, and closure standards.
body_html:
Scope

Covers service quality complaints, repeated defects, warranty dissatisfaction, and communication gaps after delivery.

Resolution Flow

  1. Acknowledge complaint within SLA and capture facts.
  2. Classify severity and assign case owner.
  3. Coordinate with service advisor and related unit.
  4. Provide customer update cadence until closure.
  5. Document root cause and prevention action.

Closure Standard

Close only after customer confirms outcome and branch records corrective action.

meta_description: SOP to handle financing exceptions such as rejection risk, restructuring requests, and policy constraints.
body_html:
Typical Edge Cases

  • Initial application rejection
  • DP readiness mismatch
  • Installment pressure after simulation
  • Document inconsistency and verification delays

Execution Standard

  1. Revalidate customer profile and required documents.
  2. Offer approved alternative DP-tenor structures.
  3. Escalate non-standard requests to finance partner PIC.
  4. Explain approval dependency and timeline transparently.

Goal

Maintain deal momentum while protecting compliance and customer trust.

h1: Delivery Delay Escalation and Recovery SOP
meta_description: SOP for managing delivery delays through transparent communication and trust-recovery actions.
body_html:
When Delay Happens

  1. Validate root cause and revised ETA internally.
  2. Inform customer proactively before promised date slips.
  3. Share revised milestone and next update schedule.
  4. Escalate critical delays to manager-led communication.

Recovery Actions

  • Use clear apology and accountability script
  • Offer realistic alternatives when available
  • Keep update cadence fixed until handover

Outcome

Reduced cancellation risk and stronger post-issue trust.

meta_description: Guardrails for objective competitor comparison based on customer criteria and verifiable facts.
body_html:
Comparison Principle

Compare only on verified data and customer-priority criteria, not assumptions.

Required Dimensions

  • Usage fit and feature relevance
  • Total cost of ownership assumptions
  • Aftersales network and support readiness
  • Delivery confidence and ownership experience

Do and Don't

Do use evidence-backed statements. Don't use speculative claims about competitor weaknesses.

h1: Warranty Claim Intake and Customer Education SOP
meta_description: SOP for intake, verification, and customer communication during warranty claim handling.
body_html:
Intake Standard

  1. Capture complaint chronology and current symptoms.
  2. Validate unit identity, service history, and warranty period.
  3. Open case record with clear ownership and SLA.

Customer Education

  • Explain what is covered vs not covered with neutral language.
  • Share inspection steps and expected decision timeline.
  • Provide next update checkpoint in writing.

Target

Reduce misunderstanding and speed up warranty decision clarity.

h1: Repeat Complaint Recovery and Manager Escalation SOP
meta_description: SOP for repeated unresolved complaints with structured recovery and leadership escalation.
body_html:
Trigger

Activate when complaint recurs after previous closure or exceeds agreed SLA.

Recovery Flow

  1. Run root-cause recheck with service lead.
  2. Assign manager-visible action plan and timeline.
  3. Communicate corrective plan with apology and accountability.
  4. Verify post-fix stability before final closure.

Outcome

Lower repeat-issue risk and stronger confidence in branch resolution quality.

meta_description: SOP to secure first-service attendance and improve aftersales retention after delivery.
body_html:
Before Due Date

  • Send reminder with schedule options.
  • Confirm preferred slot and contact channel.
  • Clarify expected service duration and preparation.

After Service

  • Check satisfaction and unresolved concerns.
  • Log next maintenance estimate and reminder date.
  • Ask for referral only after confirmed satisfaction.

Business Impact

Improves retention and long-term ownership trust.
